metadata.name: YOYO Calibration Safety Contract
metadata.purpose: Prevent noisy first-pass human labels from directly becoming Gold, coverage anchors, or production-changing evidence.

requirements: Second blind pass completed without showing first-pass label or algorithm prediction.
Hue applicability/relation and tone relation are consistent across passes.
Case is intentionally assigned to calibration/tuning split.
Case is not simultaneously in regression holdout.
Case is intentionally assigned to holdout split.
Case is never used to tune thresholds, weights, or formulas.
